pr.head: feat/p125-account-entitlement-email
pr.note: Already open (auto-created by this repo's push automation) at the moment gh pr create was run; sole commit is finalCommit above, exact match. Did not merge. Did not deploy.

missionPremise: hauska-map PR #372 (merged to hauska-map main) already reads account.email off the account-only /entitlement response body (apps/property-explorer/src/lib/accountEntitlementClient.ts line 173: email: string | null; line 282: parseEmail(pick("email"))) and falls back to "Not read" until the server sends it. Nothing server-side sent it before this lane. The wire contract is a top-level email field, string or null, on the account-only entitlement body -- locked, not renamed or reshaped.
completionPredicate: email is on PeEntitlementSnapshot; resolvePeEntitlement sets it via the existing getPeUserEmail(userId) for authenticated callers and null for anonymous; peEntitlementAccountBody carries it (account body only); peEntitlementBaseBody and the with-parcel/anonymous-per-property path are byte-unchanged; the touched unit test file is green; the repo's typecheck script exits 0; a PR against main exists citing the client contract and both out-of-scope items. MET -- verification below.
scopeBasis: Dispatch scoped this lane to the stored-field wire-up only. Two items were named explicitly out of scope and were not touched: (1) renewal date -- needs a live Stripe current_period_end API design, deliberately avoided today per the comment above peBillingIntervalForPriceId in pePaywallStripe.ts; (2) peEntitlementBaseBody, the with-parcel response shape, and the anonymous/per-property read path.
